name: @nband/boards
description: Carrier board generation for nband tiers. Deliberately outside the yarn workspace: installing tscircuit at the repository root rehoists node_modules and removes next from where eslint expects to find it, breaking lint and build for everyone who has never touched a board. This directory keeps its own node_modules and is installed on demand by `make boards-deps`.

scripts.postinstall: echo '  tscircuit installed. Run `make boards` from the repository root.'
